g.text: UC-13/14 - Detect, Evaluate and Block Website (FST-050 design boundary)
Planned contract only. FST-050 must agree browser/OS support,
mechanism, permissions, local transport and cleanup guarantees.
A window title is not proof of the website host.
read actual host and transient context
Does not match notyoutube.com or youtube.com.example.org.
Most specific matching domain wins; disabled rules ignored.
recheck session, rule and host context
Cancel; do not report successful blocking.
events (delivery may be out of order)
Report missing capability; keep timer working.
A site rule must not terminate the entire browser.
Retain host identity, not URL credentials/query or page content.
Release introduced restrictions when focus eligibility ends.
